evals.name: nothing-to-land
evals.prompt: I think we're done with the feature flags work item. Can you check whether it's ready to commit? I ran npm run check a minute ago and it was green, don't rerun it.
evals.state: Work item 001 complete on all tasks, already purged; clean tree.
evals.expected_output: Reports the gate as SKIPPED in plain terms (the landing is unverified), says there is nothing uncommitted to land and nothing to purge, does not draft a commit message for nothing, and does not invent work. Does not commit.
assertions: States the quality gate was skipped and that the result is therefore unverified
States there are no uncommitted changes to land
States the work item has no STAGE sections left to purge
Does not draft a commit message for a non-existent change
Does not run npm run check
Does not commit or modify any file

evals.name: in-flight-task-dirty-tree
evals.prompt: I've finished the cache invalidation task. Check it's ready to land - skip the check, it just passed.
evals.state: changes/002-config-caching.md exists (uncommitted) with Task 2 In Progress and STAGE 1/2 sections present; ConfigurationService.cs has an uncommitted edit adding an invalidation hook; no test change; no README change in the touched folder.
evals.expected_output: Gate SKIPPED reported loudly. Acceptance judged clause by clause from the diff hunks: the invalidation-on-write clause has partial evidence (code present, no test), stated as such. README review names the touched folders. Purge plan names STAGE 1 and STAGE 2 by heading. Commit message in 'Module N: ...' style, no conventional-commit prefix. Ends with a list of edits it is ready to make on confirmation. Does not commit, does not mark the task Complete.
assertions: Reports the gate as SKIPPED / unverified
Gives a per-clause verdict for Given, When and Then with evidence from the diff, and marks the missing test as partial or no evidence rather than met
Names the exact STAGE headings to delete from changes/002-config-caching.md
Draft commit message uses the repo's plain style, not a feat:/fix: prefix
Does not commit, does not edit the work item, does not say the stage is complete
Ends with the edits it will make on the user's confirmation
